name: Feathers for Binding
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
The other ingredient I need for the poultice is feathers from the Shadowgale shrieklings that roam this forest. In their juvenile form, the shrieklings have insulative feathers which would be ideal to put over the moss. These feathers will prevent the antiseptic sap from drying out and will provide at least some protection against the elements.

Be warned, the shrieklings are normally docile but they have been incredibly hostile of late. Their large talons can easily disembowel you if you aren't careful.
narrative.objectives: Collect 20 feathers from the Shadowgale Shrieklings in Shadowgale Forest.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thank you for these. I will be sure to use every feather so their sacrifice will not be in vain.
narrative.requestItemsText: It deeply saddens me to ask you to kill the young shrieklings, but with the rise in their aggression it is for the best. We can only handle so many emergencies at a time.

mentionedItems.name: Pristine Shriekling Feather
tooltip: "These feathers are soft and just slightly oily. Perfect for insulation against the cool, damp climates of Shadowgale Forest."
